Definition: (with the article) Gederah, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Gederah is a place in Palestine, named once in Scripture, in Joshua. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gederah matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Gederah is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
